responsibility: This umbrella machine-description file collects all NDS32 scheduler pipeline models and defines the fallback simple model. It includes the per-core pipeline descriptions for N7, N8, E8, N9 variants, N10, Graywolf, and N13/N12, then adds a trivial single-unit automaton for simple scheduling, serving as the shared inclusion point referenced from nds32.md rather than owning one specific microarchitecture itself.
